hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 separates Kanan [zkn] from Kadu [zkd] who are culturally distinct,
but the two share 82%-90% of basic vocabulary (**hh:g:Sangdong:Kadu**:30), and are arguably one language from a linguistic perspective. See also: Kado [kdv].
